levelledPara.title: Fire Protection System Overview
levelledPara.para: The fire protection system (ATA 26) provides fire detection, warning, and extinguishing capabilities for all critical aircraft zones.
The system is designed to meet certification requirements per CS-25 and operates in accordance with DO-160 environmental qualifications.

levelledPara.title: System Architecture
levelledPara.para: The fire protection system consists of three main subsystems:
- Detection (ATA 26-10): Fire and smoke detection in all protected zones
- Extinguishing (ATA 26-20): Fire suppression using approved agents
- Explosion Suppression (ATA 26-30): Inerting and ventilation for H2 and battery systems

levelledPara.title: Protected Zones
levelledPara.para: The following zones are equipped with fire protection:
1. Engine and propulsion bays
2. APU and fuel cell compartments
3. Cargo compartments
4. Lavatories
5. Avionics and electrical bays
6. Wheel wells and gear bays
7. Battery compartments

levelledPara.title: Operation
levelledPara.para: Upon fire detection, the system provides immediate visual and aural warnings to the flight crew. Automatic or manual fire extinguishing can be initiated through the fire protection control panel.
The system continuously monitors all protected zones and provides status indications on the flight deck.
